parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to query. If this parameter is not specified, the details of all used instances are returned

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the instance
parameters.name: instance_spec

parameters.help_en: The code of the resource, such as ecsRi and scu_bag. If this parameter is specified, the ProdCode parameter does not take effect for the request
parameters.help_zh: 商品code，如ecsRi、scu_bag等。如果填写该字段，则prodCode字段不生效
parameters.name: commodity_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deducted instance. If this parameter is not specified, the details of all instances are returned
parameters.help_zh: 被抵扣实例的ID，为空时返回所有实例的明细数据
parameters.name: deducted_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. For the first query, set the value to null. For subsequent queries, set the value to the token that is obtained from the NextToken parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询从LastToken之后开始返回。第一次查询填null，之后的从结果NextToken获取
parameters.name: last_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 每次查询条数，默认为20，最大值为300
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the resource plan usage of linked accounts. Valid values:

true: queries the resource plan usage of linked accounts.
false: does not query the resource plan usage of linked accounts
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含财务云子账号的资源包用量
true：包含
false：不包含
parameters.name: include_share

parameters.help_en: The code of the service. Example: ecs
parameters.name: prod_code

DeductFactorTotal.description_en: The total computing capacity or storage capacity of the RI or SCU during the deduction
DeductFactorTotal.description_zh: RI或SCU在该时间段的算力或容量总量

DeductHours.description_en: The deduct factor. This parameter is returned only if the CommodityCode parameter is set to ecsRi
DeductHours.description_zh: 抵扣系数。 仅当CommodityCode为ecsRi有效

DeductMeasure.description_zh: 原始计量量。表示用户在某段时间内实际使用的资源量，未经任何规则调整

DeductQuantity.description_en: The computing capacity or storage capacity that is deducted in a pay-as-you-go instance
DeductQuantity.description_zh:
实际抵扣对应按量实例的算力或容量。
实际抵扣量（DeductQuantity）是基于原始计量量（DeductMeasure）并结合具体抵扣规则计算得出的。

DeductedInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the deducted instance

DeductedProductDetail.description_en: The name of the deducted service
DeductedProductDetail.description_zh: 被抵商品（产品明细）名称

InstanceSpec.description_en: The instance type of the deducted instance

Region.description_en: The region in which the instance resides. This parameter can be left empty

ShareUid.description_en:
The UID of the deducted instance.

If the deduction is shared, the value of this parameter indicates the UID of the deducted instance.
If the deduction is not shared, the value of this parameter is the same as that of the uid parameter
ShareUid.description_zh:
抵扣实例所属uid
共享抵扣：抵扣实例所属uid
非共享抵扣：等于uid字段

Uid.description_en: The UID of the deducted instance

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You can set the LastToken parameter to this value in the next request. If null is returned, all results are queried
NextToken.description_zh: 下次请求查询开始标识，填充到request的LastToken字段中。如果返回为null，则标识查询结束

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
